{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that shows a small green/red status dot in the composer bar, immediately left of the model-select menu, indicating whether the DeepSeek API is currently in official peak time (red) or off-peak (green).","id":"gh:1344897887","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-deepseek-peak-indicator","slug":"DDA-DIGITAL/dsh-deepseek-peak-indicator","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that shows a small green/red status dot in the composer bar, immediate"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ly left of the model-select menu, indicating whether the DeepSeek API is currently in official peak "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"time (red) or off-peak (green)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-deepseek-peak-indicator"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that shows a small **green/red status dot** in the composer bar, immed"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"iately **left of the model-select menu**, indicating whether the DeepSeek API is currently in offici"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"al **peak time (red)** or **off-peak (green)**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Light | Dark
:---: | :---:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Dot | Meaning |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| 🟢 green | DeepSeek API **off-peak** — standard rates, usually faster |
| 🔴 red | DeepSeek API **pe"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ak time** — official peak window (rates doubled, higher load) |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Hovering the dot shows the current tier, when the next transition happens (in your local time), and "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"the official schedule. **Clicking the dot** opens a polished dashboard panel:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- a **mode pill** (`● PEAK` / `● OFF-PEAK`) with a mode-tinted hairline accent,
- a **countdown card"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"** — "Time remaining" with a live 32px tabular countdown (ticking every second; amber pulse in the f"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"inal minute) and a caption for the next transition,
- a **live token-cost card** — V4.1 Flash rates "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"(per 1M tokens, with a **元/$ switch**) for cached input, input and output, off-peak vs peak side by "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"side — the **currently active rates are highlighted**, so you see what tokens cost right now,
- a **"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"24-hour day track** — a seamless red/green gradient of peak/off-peak hours in *your* local time, wit"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"h a **"now" marker** (ring + line) aligned to exact hour ticks and a summary line,
- **stat tiles** "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"— "In this mode" (elapsed + since) and "Next" (relative + absolute time),
- a compact two-line sched"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"de" (elapsed + since) and "Next" (relative + absolute time),
- a compact two-line schedule footnote."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The panel closes on outside click, `Escape`, or the close button; **Tab cycles** the panel's control"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"s while open. It flips to the new mode automatically at a window boundary. Motion (panel entrance, p"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ill pop, marker glide) respects `prefers-reduced-motion`, and the styles use the host theme's tokens"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" so the panel matches light and dark themes."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The tier follows the official DeepSeek schedule — Models & Pricing — plus the peak/off-peak billing "},{"id":"p12s2","text":" follows the official DeepSeek schedule — Models & Pricing — plus the peak/off-peak billing notices:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> **2026-08-23** — Weekends (Saturday and Sunday, Beijing Time): the peak/off-peak time divisions no"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" longer apply — all calls are charged uniformly at the off-peak rate.
>
> **2026-09-10** — V4.1 Flas"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"h pricing takes effect (04:00 UTC). The legacy model names `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` are retired and se"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"rved as V4.1 Flash at Flash prices."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Cost card rates (per 1M tokens, peak = exactly 2× off-peak — both tables are official and never inte"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"es (per 1M tokens, peak = exactly 2× off-peak — both tables are official and never inter-converted):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| V4.1 Flash | off-peak | peak |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| input, cache hit | 元0.02 · $0.003 | 元0.04 · $0.006 |
| input, cache miss | 元1 · $0.15 | 元2 · $0.30"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" |
| output | 元4 · $0.60 | 元8 · $1.20 |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"So in Beijing time: **peak = 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, Mon–Fri** (01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"); **weekends are off-peak all day**. The day-of-week check is evaluated on the **Beijing wall clock"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"**, exactly as the billing rule states. - `lib/index.js` — no"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"de half: empty `apply`, so the row is a valid loader entry (the browser does all the work).
- `lib/c"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"lient.js` — browser half (declared via `dsh.client` + `exports["./client"]`, served at `/plugins/dsh"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"-deepseek-peak-indicator/client.js`): registers a React occupant into the **`conversation.input.righ"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"t`** UI slot.
